name: doordash_search_first_restaurant
intent: Search DoorDash for a food and report the first restaurant in the results
description: Open search in the DoorDash app, search for the requested food or query, and return the name of the first restaurant shown in the results list.
patterns: search for food and tell me the first restaurant
find the top restaurant in DoorDash
search DoorDash and name the first result
what is the first restaurant for this food

inputs.name: search_query
inputs.description: The food or search term to look up in DoorDash.

steps.intent: Tap the Search DoorDash field to start a search
Type {{search_query}} into the Search DoorDash field and submit the search

outputs.name: first_restaurant_name
outputs.near: Mountain Mike's Pizza, 9.2 mi away, Estimated time of arrival 41 min, Store is Farther away, Deal available, 20% off on…
